title: PRD edit runlog — morning pass & launch checklist
content:
03/12 morning pass — short runlog + launch readiness tidy-up

06:30 quick skim (overnight notes):
- flagged API quota language still ambiguous (sec 2.1). Need precise tokens-per-minute example.
- retention policy wording (sec 4) conflicts with ops doc; added TODO to sync with security.

07:05 edits applied (local):
- tightened acceptance criteria for bulk-embed endpoint (latency 95p <= 350ms at 4k batch).
- added NOTE: default batching policy to be opt-in for existing customers during migration window.
- replaced vague "near real-time" with "< 500ms P50 for single requests" in titan model notes.

Open questions (must resolve before staging):
- Who signs off on rate-limit messaging to customers? (stakeholder: @Ravi)
- Do we block older API keys from opt-in batching? (ops input needed)
- Migration window: 6 weeks or 12 weeks? pros/cons in comments.

Assignees + quick tasks (today):
- @Ravi: confirm billing copy for opt-in toggle (JIRA-RT-3421) — due EOD
- @Lena: test staging payloads with 2.5k tokens, multi-model route — run 50 reps and record P95
- Me (Avery): reconcile sec 4 retention vs security doc + add two-line FAQ blurb

Pre-staging checklist (tick when done):
- [ ] PR merged: prd-changes/pull/58 (small wording + sample payload)
- [ ] QA smoke script created (see below)
- [ ] Observability dashboard: add token-cost metric + 1m alert threshold
- [ ] Rollout plan updated with canary percent and fallback model
- [ ] Support playbook draft (1 page) for escalation

Quick smoke test (copy into staging job runner):
- endpoint: /v1/generate?model=redwood-titan-13b
- payloads: 1x single prompt (100 tokens), 1x batch of 4 small prompts, 1x 2.5k token stress
- check: 200 OK, time < 500ms for single, token-count in response, no 5xx
- record: P50, P95, P99 for each test type

Rollback & emergency notes (short):
- feature-flag: ff/prd-optin-batching (platform toggle)
- rollback command: curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://console.redwood.internal/flags/ff/prd-optin-batching/disable
- if 5xx > 1% for 5m -> disable flag, open incident channel #prod-launch, notify SRE (oncall: Priya)

Monitoring knobs to watch first 2 hours:
- request error rate (5m window) > 0.5% -> page SRE
- avg tokens/sec per instance > expected by 40% -> consider throttle on canary
- billing-usage spikes: if projected over-commit to reserved capacity, contact finance ops

Stakeholder sync agenda (15 min):
1) Confirm billing/UX copy (Ravi)
2) Opt-in semantics & default (Lena)
3) Rollout cadence and customer communication plan (Me)
4) Contingency: cutoff time and rollback authority

Late morning to-dos (if time):
- add two example cURLs to PRD under "migration examples" (quick copy + expected responses)
- draft a single-email template for early adopters (short bullets + known limitations)

Notes to self (voice-memo style):
- Keep PRD language minimal for legal; avoid promises about "free" performance guarantees.
- Use concrete numbers everywhere — ops hates words like "usually" or "near instant".
- Flag any place where we say "will" vs "may" — default to may unless committed.

End-of-day target (EOD 03/12):
- PRD text pass done + merge AND staging smoke green OR clear rollback plan set with stakeholders.
